welcome.title: Welcome to MediKiosk
welcome.subtitle: Kiosk-based patient history taking & clinical verification platform. Please select your role to proceed.
welcome.patientDesc: Answer adaptive intake questions and upload existing medical documents prior to your consultation.
welcome.doctorDesc: Review source-tagged patient records, inspect contradiction flags, edit, and approve consultations.
lang.title: Select Your Language
lang.subtitle: Choose your preferred language for the interactive kiosk intake interview.
complaint.title: What brings you to the doctor today?
complaint.subtitle: Please describe your primary symptoms or main health concern in your own words.
complaint.name: Patient Name (Optional)
complaint.label: Chief Complaint / Primary Symptoms *
complaint.placeholder: e.g. I have been having chest pain and shortness of breath since morning...
interview.sourceNote: Source-tagged to clinical decision tree • Voice input supported
interview.typePlaceholder: Type your response here (or tap the microphone to speak)...
interview.transcribedVia: Voice captured in {lang}. Please check the words below.
interview.ttsUnavailable: Voice playback is not available on this device — the question is shown as text.
mic.unsupported: This browser does not support microphone recording. Please type your answer below.
mic.permissionDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Please allow the microphone, or type your answer below.
mic.notFound: No microphone was found. Please type your answer below.
mic.emptyRecording: We didn't hear anything. Please try speaking again.
mic.timeout: Recording took too long and was stopped. Please try again.
mic.networkError: We couldn't send your recording. Please check the connection and try again.
mic.transcriptionFailed: We couldn't understand the recording. Please try again, or type your answer below.
mic.serviceUnavailable: Voice service is temporarily unavailable. Please type your answer below.
mic.generic: Something went wrong with the microphone. Please try again, or type your answer below.
upload.title: 📄 Upload Old Medical Documents / Reports
upload.subtitle: Upload previous prescriptions, lab results, or hospital summaries. They will be automatically read and added to your history.
upload.dropzone: Click or Drag & Drop Medical Document / Prescription Image
upload.formats: Supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP files
summary.title: Intake Completed & Source-Tagged!
summary.subtitle: Your history and uploaded documents have been compiled into a structured clinical snapshot for your doctor.
summary.unclearNote: Unclear or incomplete response — doctor review needed.
summary.safetyText: AI collects and organizes facts. Nothing reaches your permanent record without explicit physician review and approval.
redflag.title: EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Potential Acute Coronary Syndrome
redflag.expedite: ⚡ Expedite Intake — Move Immediately to Doctor Review →
err.backend: Unable to connect to the medical kiosk server. Please ask staff for help.
err.startFailed: We could not start the interview. Please ask staff for help.
err.submitFailed: We could not save your answer. Please try again.
err.uploadFailed: We could not read your document. Please try again.
err.summaryFailed: We could not prepare your summary. Please try again.
